title: Big cats compilation: 3 cats, 3 habits

scenes.headline: An adept swimmer that appears to enjoy bathing
Often carries its kill into a tree to eat
Long-haired cat of Central and South Asia's mountains

caption:
Same family, very different lifestyles.

Britannica links the tiger's love of water to its origins: it evolved in eastern Asia and tolerates heat less well than other big cats.

Source: Britannica; Animal Diversity Web.  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
